name: Kalo
description: Kalo is a mobile app that allows users to track various health and fitness metrics, including calorie and macro intake, micronutrients, exercise, sleep, mood, and more. It also provides features such as meal planning, recipe search, and community challenges.
features: Dynamic Calorie Adjustment - auto-adjusts from exercise
Psychology / Behavioural Tools - 28-day curriculum + daily quizzes
target_audience: Individuals interested in tracking their health and fitness metrics

name: UK News Now
description: UK News Now is a covert evidence gathering tool disguised as a news reader. It appears as a standard UK & world news app whilst silently capturing, logging, and securing evidence in the background. Features include curated UK & world headlines with breaking news alerts, covert evidence gathering with an AI companion trained in domestic & narcissistic abuse support, timestamped and geotagged journal entries for legally admissible evidence, silent recording and silent photo capture whilst browsing the news, and a secure encrypted vault with remote server backup.
features: Curated UK & world news headlines with breaking news alerts
Covert evidence gathering with AI companion for domestic & narcissistic abuse support
Timestamped and geotagged journal entries for legally admissible evidence
Silent audio recording whilst browsing the news page
Secure encrypted vault with remote server backup
Disguised as a standard news reader app
target_audience: Individuals in vulnerable domestic situations who need to gather evidence discreetly whilst staying informed about UK & world news

name: Write AI
description: Write AI is a multi-tool AI writing application powered by OpenAI's GPT-4o. It combines 7 specialised writing tools, an application tracker, and ATS keyword scoring into a single app available on both Android and Web. Unlike most AI writing apps that focus on one use case, Write AI covers the entire writing needs of job seekers, students, professionals, and anyone who needs to produce written content quickly — all in one place. The app is built with Next.js 14, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript, with a native Android version powered by Capacitor.
target_audience: Job seekers, students, professionals, and anyone who needs to produce written content quickly

name: MindScape
description: MindScape is a neuroscience-based mental wellness app that uses clinically-researched binaural beats, vagal nerve stimulation, and somatic trauma release to regulate the nervous system. Unlike generic meditation apps that offer guided meditations with celebrity voices, MindScape is built on peer-reviewed neuroscience — every session targets specific brainwave states and neurological pathways proven to reduce stress and anxiety. The app is designed for users dealing with anxiety, sleep issues, trauma recovery (including C-PTSD), and those seeking peak mental performance. It combines audio therapy, visual entrainment (strobe), breathwork, and adaptive personalization into a single platform.
target_audience: Users dealing with anxiety, sleep issues, trauma recovery (including C-PTSD), and those seeking peak mental performance

name: Camp Compass
description: Camp Compass is a navigation tool designed for outdoor enthusiasts and campers. The app provides directional guidance and location tracking to help users navigate trails, campsites, and outdoor adventures with confidence.
